thread:
olivia: Heads-up: iterating on a new top-toolbar for billing controls. Main idea: move token/$ toggle + scope selector (org/project) into a persistent header so users don't hunt for it in each chart. Thoughts?

dez: Strong yes for persistence. Users keep asking why the chart view isn't sticky across pages. :eyes:

harper: Two quick concerns: 1) small screens 2) people accidentally exporting CSVs when they mean PDF. Can we separate export CTAs more clearly?

cal: For mobile, collapsing to an icon group is ok. We should include a single accessible label like: `aria-label=\"Billing controls: display units and scope\"`. Tooltip should state which scope is active.

olivia: Good call on exports. Proposing explicit CTAs: "Download PDF (invoice)" and "Export CSV (line items)"; move "Export chargeback CSV" under kebab menu with confirmation.

dez: Chart behavior idea: default compact sparklines, with a keyboard-focusable `Details` affordance that expands into a stacked breakdown overlay. That keeps dashboard density but surfaces breakdowns.

harper: Accessibility: token-type colors need pattern overlays for print + at least 4.5 contrast. Also avoid color pairs that rely on red/green. Add tooltip text describing token categories for screen readers.

cal: Dev request: can design provide two card widths (full and compact) and a spec for the icon-only toolbar state including CSS tokens for spacing and focus ring? I'll prototype once I have tokens.

olivia: I'll update mocks with: top-right persistent toolbar, icon-only mobile state, two card widths, and separate export CTAs. Will include aria/tooltip copy and color contrast notes. Sharing in #design in ~40m.

billing-bot: Export spec updated: /internal/billing/export-spec-2026-03.md (link)

dez: One more UX nit: show a small persistent label after toggle with current scope, e.g., "Viewing: Org — Acme Corp" so people don't mistakenly think they're in project view.

harper: Agree. Also add a tiny "Reset to org" quick action for admins when they change scope.

cal: Sounds actionable. I'll mock responsive collapse and keyboard interactions. tagging @eng-frontend so we can sync on spacing tokens.

olivia: Thanks all — action items: design mocks + copy updates, accessibility checklist, separate export CTAs, and a prototype-ready token sheet. Will ping when ready.
